itens.descricao_en: 词光 · Word Atlas — Illustrated IELTS vocabulary with 7,298 words, UK/US audio and FSRS review. Open-source app + CC BY 4.0 dataset.
itens.readme:
# 词光 · Word Atlas
**把单词变成画面，让复习有迹可循。**
7,298 个雅思词条 · 原创插画 · 英美发音 · FSRS 间隔复习
[**立即体验 ↗**](https://0xlei.tech/words/)　 /　 [48 秒介绍](docs/assets/launch.mp4)　 /　 [下载词库](data/)　 /　 [English](README.en.md)
[ ](LICENSE)
[ ](CONTENT_LICENSE.md)
**词光 iOS App 已在 App Store 上架，免费下载：[App Store · 搜索「词光」](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6827459612)**
[ ](https://x.com/yangleiocx3)
---
词光是一款以插画和语境为核心的雅思背词应用。看画面理解词义，听发音建立联系，再用主动回忆和间隔复习巩固记忆。无需账号，学习进度保存在自己的设备上。
> **版本说明**：这个仓库提供词光的开源基础版及配套数据集。在线网站独立迭代，功能与仓库可能不同；仓库里的代码和内容分别遵循下方的 MIT / CC BY 4.0 授权。
[产品预览](#产品预览) · [学习方式](#学习方式) · [本地运行](#本地运行) · [开放数据](#开放数据) · [参与贡献](#参与贡献)
## 产品预览
### 一本可以听、可以练的单词图鉴
  每日计划，把注意力放在今天  插画、词义、发音，在一张词卡里  
 以上为仓库开源版的实际界面。页首为品牌概念插画。 
### 学过的词，汇成自己的星图
19 个话题组成词汇星图。拖动旋转、滚动缩放，点击星星打开词卡；学习状态用不同亮度呈现。采用 WebGL2 渲染，不支持的设备提供降级显示。
  看 48 秒宣传片  
[播放完整视频（含声音）](docs/assets/launch.mp4)
## 学习方式
| 环节 | 你会做什么 |
| :--- | :--- |
| **看见** | 每个词配一幅插画、中英释义、两条原创例句，以及搭配、词族和用法提示。 |
| **听见** | 切换英音、美音，听日常例句朗读；部分词条另含第二条例句录音。 |
| **想起** | 看义选词、看图补句、听音辨词、拼写，逐步练习主动回忆。 |
| **复习** | FSRS 根据学习记录安排复习，目标记忆率可调。只有首次作答计入正确率。 |
| **积累** | 星图展示学习进度；打字练习独立统计；支持导出和恢复本地进度。 |
**本地优先。** 无需注册；看过的词条与媒体可缓存供离线使用。换设备前，请先导出进度备份。
  听发音、例句与环境声样本  
拿 *abandon* 举例，点开就能听（在线播放）：
| | |
|---|---|
| 🇬🇧 英音 | [abandon /əˈbændən/](https://0xlei.tech/words/atlas/audio/uk/abandon.mp3) |
| 🇺🇸 美音 | [abandon /əˈbændən/](https://0xlei.tech/words/atlas/audio/us/abandon.mp3) |
| 📖 例句朗读 | [We had to abandon our car in the snow.](https://0xlei.tech/words/atlas/audio/ex/abandon.mp3) |
全部 7,298

itens.descricao_en: A self-hosted job search and resume builder app that writes tailored resumes and cover letters from your profile.
itens.readme:
Dossier 
  Your job search, on your own server: one profile, a tailored resume and cover letter for every job, and every application tracked from draft to offer.
Dossier keeps your career history in one profile and turns it into a clean resume. For every job you apply to, it reads the posting, shows how you match, and drafts a tailored resume and cover letter that only use facts from your profile. You refine them in a chat, download them as PDFs and track each application from draft to offer.
It's for one person on a small server: one password, your data in your own PostgreSQL database (or a single SQLite file), and an AI model of your choice. That can be a local model through Ollama or LM Studio, so your profile and documents stay on your own hardware, or a hosted one (any OpenAI-compatible API, Anthropic or Mistral), which then receives what it writes from. [Privacy](https://github.com/AienTech/dossier/wiki/Privacy) says what goes where.
**Get started:** [run it on your computer](#run-it-on-your-computer) in a few minutes, or [self-host it](#self-hosting) on a server. The [installation guide](https://github.com/AienTech/dossier/wiki) covers every way: Docker with or without Compose, Node.js, a plain Ubuntu server, CapRover, Coolify and Dokploy.

itens.descricao_en: Chain region scanner: find proxy configs that get you into Google AI Studio and Gemini (signed-in browser check, anti-DPI, Windows/macOS/Linux/Android)
itens.readme:
English  ·  فارسی 
# Gemini Config Checker
Find proxy configs that actually get you into **Google AI Studio and Gemini**, by testing each one the way a person would: in a
*signed-in* browser, through the route you will really use.
> **Version 0.1.0, early pre-release.** It works end to end on Windows (the only platform it has been run on so far). The macOS,
> Linux and Android builds come from the CI pipeline and have not been exercised on real devices yet. Please report what you find.
## Two modes, one switch
The big **Simple / Advanced** switch in the header decides what is tested. The route diagram under the title morphs to show it.
| | **Simple** | **Advanced** |
|---|---|---|
| Question it answers | *Which of my configs work?* | *Which free configs work through my config?* |
| Route | you → **config** → AI Studio / Gemini | you → **base config** → **free config** → AI Studio / Gemini |
| You provide | your configs (links, a subscription URL or base64), or pick a ready-made free list | one working base config, plus a free list or pasted configs |
| Anti-DPI profile is applied to | every config under test (each one connects from your machine) | the base config's first hop (free configs run inside its tunnel) |
| Typical use | check a pile of configs you already have; test a config before you rely on it | your Cloudflare config works, but you need a *different exit* that Google accepts |
| Export | links, base64, a full Xray config of one config | links, base64, a chain Xra
